thread:
alyssa (CS): FYI flagged during EOM recon for BlueWave — dashboard total and invoice total differ by $2.4k. invoice missing three line items and plan tier on invoice reads 'Starter' but dashboard shows 'Pro'. can someone take a quick look? :eyes:
jin (Support): account id and invoice#? any screenshots or csv export?
alyssa (CS): acct=BW-4432 invoice=inv_2024_11_30_4432 attaching export (pasted below). dashboard shows 1.2M tokens ; invoice shows 1.05M tokens.
alyssa (CS): ```csv
account,period,line,plan,tokens,amount
BW-4432,2024-11,generate,Pro,400000,80.00
BW-4432,2024-11,embed,Pro,800000,160.00
BW-4432,2024-11,reserved-burst,Pro,100000,20.00
```
matt (Billing): thanks. quick hypothesis: looks like the invoice was generated from a snapshot taken at 00:00 UTC before a late ingest/backfill completed. do we have any backfill runs around cutoff?
ingest-bot: backfill job "monthly-embed-backfill" completed for BW-4432 at 2024-12-01T02:14:07Z, rows_added=3, tokens_added=150000
jin (Support): that would explain the 150k token gap. invoice generated at 2024-12-01T00:05Z per billing logs.
rebecca (Finance): if backfill finished after snapshot, we should either re-run invoice or apply a one-off credit. what's our policy for late ingestion?
eli (Eng): Paging infra — monthly snapshot job runs at 00:00 UTC, but backfill jobs can finish up to +6h. we can re-run billing snapshot and regenerate invoice but will need accounting signoff.
tara (Ops): ops-alert-bot shows a retry burst for the embed pipeline at 23:50 UTC which delayed writes into metering until 01:58 UTC.
steve (Account): customer is on an annual contract; they will escalate if billed incorrectly. can we do a provisional credit now while we verify? :pray:
matt (Billing): propose: issue temporary credit for $2400 (matches tokens*rate) and create a corrected invoice once snapshot recomputed. rebecca ok with that?
rebecca (Finance): yes, provisional credit ok. include note: "awaiting final invoice recompute due to late ingestion/backfill". please record ledger id when done.
jin (Support): Alyssa — I'll message the customer with a short note and the provisional credit amount. can you assign a ticket to eng to re-run snapshot + regenerate invoice and include job ids?
alyssa (CS): on it. created ticket MS-1287 and cc'd eli. added logs + ingest-bot output.
eli (Eng): I'll pick MS-1287. quick triage: looks like the metering consumer marks rows with ingestion_timestamp; invoice pipeline uses snapshot at cutoff. fix options: (1) move snapshot later, (2) block backfills after cutoff, (3) backfill reconciliation step to include late rows before invoice generation. I'll draft a patch for option 3 as it minimizes customer impact.
ops-alert-bot: incident MS-1287 labeled "metering-late-ingest-reconcile" severity=P2
jin (Support): thanks everyone. next steps: 1) billing provisional credit issued (matt) 2) eng ticket MS-1287 to recompute and regenerate invoice (eli) 3) notify customer with provisional credit note (alyssa/steve) 4) postmortem and follow-up change to snapshot/backfill window (eli/tara).
alyssa (CS): customer notified. they acknowledged and appreciated quick action. closing loop here but will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
eli (Eng): will post ETA on MS-1287 by EOD and include repro steps for QA: sample query used to compute tokens and the two timestamps for snapshot vs backfill.
matt (Billing): credit recorded: ledger_ref=LEDG-77821 amount=2400.00 reason="EOM late ingestion backfill"
rebecca (Finance): logging for audit. mark thread closed after regenerated invoice lands.
alyssa (CS): thanks team, marking resolved for CS — will re-open if regenerated invoice still mismatches.
